case_number: 2024 INSC 221, Criminal Appeal No. of 2024 (@ SLP (Criminal) No. 2044 of 2021 and SLP (Criminal) No. 2685 of 2021
summary: Disproportionate assets case; charge framing upheld; public servant R.C. Sabharwal charged with possessing Rs. 2,05,63,341/- disproportionate assets; son Puneet charged for abetment via benami transactions; standard: 'grave suspicion' sufficient to frame charges; Section 106 Evidence Act shifts burden to accused to explain assets; Income Tax Tribunal's findings on trust income considered; PC Act 1988 Sections 13(1)(e), 13(2) applicable; High Court's dismissal affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(e), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding charges under PC Act affirmed.
